name: Dakotaraptor
isnote: Described as a large dromaeosaurid (DePalma et al. 2015; PBDB Dromaeosaurinae); the cited Wikipedia revision treats it only as a maniraptoriform because part of the material was questioned.
sum: Large theropod from the end-Cretaceous Hell Creek Formation of South Dakota, described as a giant dromaeosaurid.
holotype: A partial skeleton from a fluvial bonebed in Harding County, South Dakota, found by Robert DePalma in 2005.
biology: Potentially one of the last dromaeosaurids before the end-Cretaceous extinction.
author: DePalma et al. 2015

sources.text: R. A. DePalma, D. A. Burnham, and L. D. Martin, P. L. Larson, R. T. Bakker. 2015. The first giant raptor (Theropoda: Dromaeosauridae) from the Hell Creek Formation. The University of Kansas Paleontological Contributions 14:1-16
